description: This Java class `JavaFieldsConsumer` implements the `ConfigurationConsumer` interface and handles the creation of a Java source file defining configuration fields. It accumulates field definitions, and upon completion, writes them into a `Fields.java` class file within the specified directory.

classes.name: JavaFieldsConsumer
classes.description: A class that consumes configuration data and generates a Java source file with configuration fields.

methods.name: JavaFieldsConsumer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the consumer with the writer, state, and output path.

methods.name: startFile
methods.description: Method called at the start of processing a file; currently no operation.

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Method called at the end of processing a file; triggers writing of the generated Java fields to disk.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles the end of a data structure; triggers writing Java fields if the reader state stack is empty.

methods.name: writeFields
methods.description: Static method that writes the accumulated fields and class boilerplate into the specified Java file.
